## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:cli` · `area:api` · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-16T20:02Z

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p3:** a 405 without the `Allow` header RFC 9110 asks for. The status is right, and the mcp, meta and ai domains already send the header.
- **Serial note:** PR #24009 (#23909) is on the same `packages/runtime` domain files.

Claim: PM loop round 2 · 2026-10-17T21:36Z
Session: `session_01QyoWKK9RwUNxBxmevy9Neb`
Account: `marchtian` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; always the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-24023-keys-actions-405-allow`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-24023`
Domain: `domain:cli`
Seat: `domain:cli#2` (seat post #22648)
File surface (read on `origin/main` `aa31569b2`; line numbers move; stop on a breach and explain it in the report):
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/keys.ts`, `handleKeysRequest`'s method check (`deps.error('Method not allowed', 405)`, about `:112`).
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/actions.ts`, the same 405 (about `:446`).
- Any other `405` built without `Allow` under `packages/runtime/src/domains`. Today there are two, read in this act (`git grep` for `405` in non-test files).
- Pins beside them under `packages/runtime/src/domains/`.
- The `createHonoApp` host path, only if measurement shows it drops the header. That is `domain:cli` too.
- One `.changeset/24023-*.md`.
- ⛔ Hold-offs: `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts` (#24210's claimed surface), `packages/runtime/src/security/**`, every `packages/spec` path.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: TIER_DEFAULT` (this run's `dispatch-gates.mjs --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: "Model tier — no path-derived mandate")
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `packages/runtime`'s keys and actions domains build their 405 with `deps.error`, which carries no headers | none: the mcp, meta and ai domains hand-roll their 405 with `Allow`, and nothing shared covers these two | any client that sends a non-allowed verb to `/api/v1/keys` or `/api/v1/actions`, measured by the filer on a stock standalone showcase boot; no named reader of `Allow` today (NOT MEASURED)
Thread-read: 6223670410
Serial constraints cleared: triage's serial note names PR #24009 (#23909) on the same domain files; it merged as `9e797a897`. No open PR touches `keys.ts` or `actions.ts` (all 4 open PRs' file lists read in this act). No `pm:dispatched` claim in any lane names either file. #24210's claim holds `domains/meta.ts`, which is outside this surface. The `pm:on-hold` cards' `Restart-touch:` / `Restart-when:` lines name none of these paths.
Scope: the maintainer, in this session's chat, verbatim: 「p3 任务也可以开始处理」 (this seat's scope is now p1/p2/p3).
